adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new client-side embed behavior in `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js` (origin check `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` and handling `{type: 'discourse-resize', height: ...}` to set `iframe.height`) plus the server-side handshake in `app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb` (`parent.postMessage({type: 'discourse-resize', height: ...}, '<%= request.referer %>')`). There are Ruby/controller/model specs added, but no JavaScript/spec coverage (no `spec/javascripts` or equivalent) for this new non-trivial embed resizing/origin logic, so a regression here would go undetected by CI.
